text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT: SEV2 - CUDA VMEM_SPILL detected on pool-us-west2a-accel-3 (pd_incident: PD-88421). Auto-page to eng-oncall.
pagerduty: Incident PD-88421 acknowledged by tilly (oncall) — routing updates to channel.
tilly: acked, looking. Initial graphs show spike in vmem usage + fragmentation. PIDs: 3489, 3490. Impact: elevated tail latency on gen-api for a small subset of customers.
tilly: checked nvml:
```
GPU 0: vmem_total 40GB, vmem_used 39.2GB, alloc_failures: 23, fragmentation: high
CUDA error seen in logs: cudaMemcpyAsync failed: out of memory
```
maria: thanks. can you isolate which model variant is running on those tasks? also any recent rollout to that pool?
tilly: running rwd-model-7b-int8 on those pods, revision b3. No recent rollouts in last 2h. Traffic pattern shows a few big long-context requests from customer: searchlytics-inc and quickchat.ai — looks correlated.
ops-bot: evict command queued: `kubectl drain node=pool-us-west2a-accel-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` (dry-run false). Starting evict now.
ops-bot: eviction step 1/3 complete: 4 pods gracefully terminated, 2 evicted to fallback pool-us-west2b. Autoscaler triggered +2 small-gpu nodes.
tilly: routing fallback to rwd-model-7b-compact (smaller KV/less vmem). Applied canary redirect rule for affected route.
maria: good. open question: customer impact messaging — CS please standby (cc @cs-bot). Can we estimate number of customers affected and duration?
tilly: current counts: ~3 customers show increased 95p latency > 1.5s for last 4m. No full failures, 503 spike minimal. I estimate mitigation in ~10-20m once evictions settle.
cs-bot: alerted CS triage, preparing template message: "We’re investigating elevated latency affecting some customers; mitigation in progress. We’ll update in 30 minutes." Will send if impact persists.
samir: ping — taking over handoff at 18:30PT. Samir oncall, will monitor rollback and confirm as stable. ETA on full coldstart/reschedule 18m based on eviction progress.
tilly: handing off logs + nvml traces to samir. Short summary: vmem spill / alloc failures on pool-us-west2a; evicted pods to fallback; canary to compact model; autoscale adding capacity.
samir: got it, looking at traces now. If fragmentation persists i'll trigger node recycle and force scheduler to avoid that host. Also will run `nvidia-smi -q` health check on drained node.
maria: for postmortem, please capture: root cause hypothesis (large long-context requests + fragmentation), mitigation steps (evict, fallback, autoscale), customer impact (3 customers elevated latency, no 100% outage), timeline.
tilly: noted. tagging PD-88421 and will leave it open until stable.
pagerduty: Incident PD-88421 status: acknowledged -> in progress. Next: escalate to oncall-senior if not resolved by 19:00PT.
ops-bot: node pool-us-west2a-accel-3 marked cordoned. Eviction finalization in progress.
samir: marking as active handoff; will update channel in 15m with status. If resolved earlier i'll post closure.
tilly: thanks — leaving channel. :wave:
samir: 15m check: latency back to baseline for two customers, third still at 95p ~1.2s. nvml fragmentation reduced after evict. Planning node recycle after business hours unless it regresses.
cs-bot: CS updated customers with interim note. No escalations yet.
samir: closing loop — PD ticket updated with mitigation steps. Will open a follow-up runbook item for vmem spill detection -> automated fallback to compact model earlier.
ops-bot: cleanup: drained node flagged for maintenance window; autoscaler scaled down extra nodes after stabilization.
samir: resolving alert in PagerDuty now. Thanks team.
pagerduty: Incident PD-88421 resolved by samir. Summary posted to incident timeline.
cs-bot: CS will send a short RFC to affected customers summarizing root cause and actions tomorrow.
